DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Thrombocytopenic Purpura (ITP)

The presence of pinpoint, non-blanching red spots (petechiae) on your extremities is a critical finding that distinguishes this condition from simple iron deficiency anemia. Based on your age, fatigue, and these specific skin findings, I have reached a diagnosis. Please see my office tomorrow as I will need to discuss the next steps for your treatment.
